audit: candidate for the P2P agent class
note_on_spread: Where compra equals venta the series carries no spread, so the class contributes to the headline and not to any friction column. That column has no source anyway (prereg 3.2a).

refereed.bias: No clean sign, which is worse than a known direction: a stale control would track blue through its own staleness, and whether that inflates or deflates its premium against blue depends on which way blue moved.
refereed.why: There is no central bank for a crypto market and no second full-window collector. CriptoYa publishes bid and ask across thirty-six venues but only for the current moment. So this is the one series in stage B5 that b5_orphan_availability.md 7.4's referee requirement cannot be applied to, and the exemption is structural rather than an oversight.
